plan.failureSummary: The cached page.ai script replayed a stale positional CSS selector that targeted the 'Solutions' header menu button instead of 'Developers', leading to navigation to a solutions page and causing the downstream URL assertion to fail.
observedIndicators: The cached page.ai instruction used a positional selector `#nav > nav > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(2) > button` to target the 'Developers' button.
Execution logs show the tool clicked the 'Solutions' button (`<button class="nav-item"...>Solutions</button>`) using that cached selector.

The browser arrived at `https://www.checklyhq.com/solutions/use-cases/critical-user-flows/` instead of `https://www.checklyhq.com/docs/`, causing `expect(page.url()).toEqual('https://www.checklyhq.com/docs/')` to fail.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear page.ai cache and re-run automation
remediationSteps.details: Purge the cached page.ai instructions for checkly.test.ts so that page.ai re-evaluates the prompt against the current site layout.

plan.notes: Clearing the page.ai cache will force Donobu to dynamically re-evaluate the site header and click the correct 'Developers' menu button.
